tools.description: Read reminders filtered by account/list IDs, completion, deadline presence, numeric priorities, due status and case-insensitive name-or-notes substring. Filters intersect; empty ID arrays match nothing. Supply criteria in filter. dueFrom and timestamp dueBefore bound deadline instants (inclusive/exclusive). All-day deadlines use midnight in their source zone. Calendar-day dueOnOrAfter and date-only dueBefore use reporting days; do not mix bound modes. orderBy supports NAME, DUE_DATE, PRIORITY, CREATION_DATE, MODIFICATION_DATE, COMPLETION_DATE with ASC/DESC, nulls last, and ID ascending ties. Omitted orderBy uses identifier order; priorities use numeric order. Cursor is the next page offset; keep criteria and limit unchanged across pages. Optional unavailable values are omitted. Dates retain their stored components; omitted hours mean date-only and omitted zones mean floating. A reminder whose dates, alarms, or recurrence cannot be projected fails the call. Flags, alert dates, containers, and emblems are not included.

relativeOffset.description: Seconds from the start date. Zero alone does not distinguish absolute and relative triggers.

structuredLocation.description: The location of a geofence trigger, when set.

radius.description: Radius in meters; zero means the system default.

daysOfMonth.description: Days 1..31 or -31..-1 counting backward from the end of the month. Monthly rules only.

daysOfWeek.description: Weekday constraints. Null means unconstrained. Not allowed for daily rules.

ordinal.description: Occurrence of this weekday: 1 is first, -1 last; omit for every occurrence. Valid range -53..53 excluding zero; non-null ordinals require monthly or yearly frequency.

daysOfYear.description: Year days 1..366 or -366..-1 counting backward from year end. Yearly rules only.

end.description: When repetition stops; null means no specified end.

count.description: Positive number of occurrences; mutually exclusive with until.

until.description: Inclusive end timestamp; mutually exclusive with count.

interval.description: Positive number of frequency units between occurrences.

setPositions.description: Select positions 1..366 or -366..-1 from occurrences matching the other constraints in each period. Requires another selector.

weeksOfYear.description: Week numbers 1..53 or -53..-1 counting backward from year end. Yearly rules only.

recurrence.description: A single repeating schedule; null when no recurrence is configured. recurrenceRules holds the stored rules.

recurrenceRules.description: Recurrence rules exactly as stored; empty when none.

calendarIdentifier.description: Calendar the rule is evaluated in.

weekNumber.description: Signed ordinal; zero means every occurrence.

end.description: When repetition stops; null for no end.

occurrenceCount.description: Number of occurrences; zero when unset.

firstDayOfTheWeek.description: First day of the week, Sunday = 1; zero is unset.

frequency.description: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, or unknown.

startDate.description: The date and time at which work on the reminder starts; Reminders may set it when a due date is set.

timeZone.description: IANA time-zone identifier, or null for floating/local date interpretation. Dates written in UTC report GMT.

url.description: An associated absolute URL; does not promise a rich-link preview in Reminders.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page; absent on the last page.

totalCount.description: Number of matching reminders before pagination.

tools.description: Read one reminder with component and projected dates, alarms and recurrence; returns null when absent. Dates, alarms, or recurrence that cannot be projected fail the call. Flags, alert dates, containers, and emblems are not included.

id.description: Identifier of the reminder.

tools.name: reminders_get

alarms.description: Configured alerts; an empty list means no alerts. rawAlarms holds the stored values.

at.description: The date and time at which the alert triggers.

offsetSeconds.description: Seconds from the start date: negative before, zero at, positive after.

geofence.description: Region and direction that trigger the alert.

proximity.description: Whether entering or leaving the region triggers the alert.

radiusMeters.description: Radius in meters. Zero requests the system default; positive values request a minimum radius.

title.description: Optional display name of the location.

allDayDueDate.description: The calendar date on which the reminder is due, without a time of day.

allDayStartDate.description: A date-only start, without a time of day.

body.description: The notes attached to the reminder.

completed.description: Whether the reminder is marked completed.

completionDate.description: The date and time the reminder was completed.

creationDate.description: The date and time the reminder was created.

dueDate.description: The date and time by which the reminder is due.

dueDay.description: The deadline's calendar day: timed deadlines in the host zone, all-day deadlines as stored. Null when undated or unclassifiable.

externalId.description: Identifier assigned by the account's server; unlike id, copies may share it.

flagged.description: Set in reminders_create/reminders_update results when the write set flagged.

id.description: Unique identifier of the reminder. Treat this value as opaque.

location.description: Descriptive location text, separate from location-triggered alarms.

modificationDate.description: The date and time the reminder was last modified.

priority.description: The priority of the reminder: 0 none, 1–4 high, 5 medium, or 6–9 low.
